critical_code_review_comments: [GOOD] Idempotent admin seed: re-hashes password if env ADMIN_PASSWORD changed — verified working. Exhibitions seed runs only on empty collection.

[GOOD] Auth: bcrypt for password hashing, JWT (HS256, 24h) Bearer header, axios interceptor auto-logouts on 401 only when an Authorization header was present (so public 401s don't redirect public site visitors).

[GOOD] Registrations are read-only by design — no DELETE endpoint exists in server.py and UI has no per-row delete button (verified by querying buttons inside leads-table = 0). Matches user requirement 'NEVER deletable'.
[GOOD] Excel export uses openpyxl with proper Content-Disposition + expose_headers in CORS so axios blob download with content-disposition filename works cross-origin.
[GOOD] _id is excluded from every Mongo find via projection {_id:0}.

[NIT] React dev warning seen in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside filter-exhibition select — caused by Emergent's instrumentation injecting a wrapper <span data-ve-dynamic> into <option> children. This is a dev-only artifact (build-tool injected; style display:contents) and does NOT affect functionality. No action needed; will not appear in production build.

[NIT] LeadsTab polling every 3s is fine for a small admin panel but each poll re-issues the full filtered query. If the leads collection grows beyond ~50k rows, consider switching to (a) websocket / SSE or (b) only-poll-when-tab-visible (document.visibilityState).
[NIT] AdminDashboard.jsx file is 327 lines and contains 3 components — manageable but on the upper edge; splitting LeadsTab + ExhibitionsTab into their own files would improve maintainability.
[NIT] AdminLogin doesn't have brute-force lockout (system prompt mentions 5-fail lockout). Not a blocker for an internal-only admin panel with a strong password but worth noting.
